entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:1
segments: ¶So I returned, and considered all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold the tears of [such as were] oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors [there was] power; but they had no comforter. {side: Heb. hand}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:2
segments: Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:3
segments: Yea, better [is he] than both they, which hath not yet been, who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:4
segments: ¶Again, I considered all travail, and every right work, that for this a man is envied of his neighbour. This [is] also vanity and vexation of spirit. {every...: Heb. all the rightness of work} {for this...: Heb. this is the envy of a man from his neighbour}

words.text: . {every...: Heb. all the rightness of work} {for this...: Heb. this is the envy of a man from his neighbour}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:5
segments: The fool foldeth his hands together, and eateth his own flesh.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:6
segments: Better [is] an handful [with] quietness, than both the hands full [with] travail and vexation of spirit.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:7
segments: ¶Then I returned, and I saw vanity under the sun.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:8
segments: There is one [alone], and [there is] not a second; yea, he hath neither child nor brother: yet [is there] no end of all his labour; neither is his eye satisfied with riches; neither [saith he], For whom do I labour, and bereave my soul of good? This [is] also vanity, yea, it [is] a sore travail.

words.text: ; neither [saith he], For whom do I labour

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:9
segments: Two [are] better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:10
segments: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him [that is] alone when he falleth; for [he hath] not another to help him up.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:11
segments: Again, if two lie together, then they have heat: but how can one be warm [alone]?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:12
segments: And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:13
segments: ¶Better [is] a poor and a wise child than an old and foolish king, who will no more be admonished. {who...: Heb. who knoweth not to be admonished}

words.text: . {who...: Heb. who knoweth not to be admonished}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:14
segments: For out of prison he cometh to reign; whereas also [he that is] born in his kingdom becometh poor.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:15
segments: I considered all the living which walk under the sun, with the second child that shall stand up in his stead.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 4:16
segments: [There is] no end of all the people, [even] of all that have been before them: they also that come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also [is] vanity and vexation of spirit.
